title: Link reload answer
description: What a gateway returns on its link for a GET of a run's configuration by its run id, the reload, a 200, application/json, unsigned: the link's transport authenticates it. The policy in force for the run, its digest, the run's variables, placeholders, reserved names and image, and nothing of the run's secrets: the proxy secret and the certificate authority are given once, in the run answer. A member Forager does not recognise is ignored.

version.description: The document format. Forager refuses a version it does not read.

policy.description: The policy in force for the run now: the one the gateway holds for it, narrowed by the run request's narrowing when it had one. Absent when there is none, and the gateway observes everything.

image.description: The image the run has, when it has a wall: the one of the run answer, since the image is fixed when the run starts.
